verdict.rationale: Retell provides webhooks for real-time call events (call_started, call_ended, call_analyzed), an analytics dashboard for tracking success rate/latency/cost/concurrency, and AI QA scoring for hallucination/sentiment/tool usage trends — these together give visibility into live production behavior and quality degradation. However, there's no documented native alerting/paging system (e.g., threshold-based alerts, PagerDuty/Slack integration) that proactively notifies a platform-engineer when error rates spike; a team would need to build that on top of webhooks themselves. missing for 10: native alerting/notification thresholds, real-time dashboards for concurrent live calls in-progress (vs historical analytics), third-party monitoring integration docs (PagerDuty/Slack/Datadog), independent evidence of alerting reliability in production.
